name: The Plane by St Clement's

location.address: corner of Nove Mlyny and Klimentska, opposite the Church of St Clement, 110 00 Praha 1

verified_sources: Czech register of memorial trees (Pamatny strom), girth 342cm measured 2017
access: Free, on a public street corner
transport: Petrska ctvrt, Nove Mesto; tram 3, 8 or 24 to Prazska trznice or Revolucni, short walk
verify_notes: A designated memorial tree (Pamatny strom) on the corner of Nove Mlyny and Klimentska, opposite the Church of St Clement, 342cm girth measured in 2017. It stands 250 metres from the already-published Rasnovka oak (prg_016), forming a small two-tree pocket in the Petrska quarter. Single-sourced to the Czech memorial tree register, flagged accordingly; no independent second source found.
